R0_BBD.title: History of benign breast disease
R0_BBD.x-derivation: Set to 1 if any of the following are present in the BreastDisease section: (a) the direct question on benign breast disease/abnormality is answered 'Yes' (R0_BBD_Abnormality=1); (b) at least one episode is recorded with a type (R0_BBD_Type) or a coded procedure (R0_BBD_ProcedureType); (c) any 'extra' procedure flags indicate biopsy, part/lump removed, whole breast removed, both breasts removed, or other (R0_BBD_Biopsy/Lump/Mastec/BothRem/Other = 1); (d) 'further' or 'more than 4' boxes are ticked (R0_BBD_Further=1 or R0_BBD_MoreThan4=1). Set to 0 if the direct question is 'No' (R0_BBD_Abnormality=2) and no other evidence is present. Otherwise, null. Derived from: R0_BBD_Abnormality, R0_BBD_Type, R0_BBD_ProcedureType, R0_BBD_Biopsy, R0_BBD_Lump, R0_BBD_Mastec, R0_BBD_BothRem, R0_BBD_Other, R0_BBD_Further, R0_BBD_MoreThan4
